citation.characteristics: Elkins, Zachary and Tom Ginsburg. 2025. Characteristics of National Constitutions, Version 5.0. Comparative Constitutions Project.

coverage.note: Complete country-year panel through 2019; from 2020 the source records constitutional events only. A country with no row after 2019 had no recorded constitutional event, which is not the same as missing data.

endurance.forecast: Not published. A per-country expected-remaining-life model failed its walk-forward backtest at the most recent cut, under-predicting survival by roughly a third, because constitutions written since 1990 outlive the historical base rate.

countries.name: Brunei
countries.adoptedNote: Adopted 1959, while still a British protected state.

countries.name: Croatia
countries.adoptedNote: Adopted 22 December 1990, while still within Yugoslavia.

countries.name: Germany
countries.note: German Federal Republic. Code 255 carries what came before.

countries.name: Lebanon
countries.adoptedNote: Adopted 23 May 1926, under the French mandate.

countries.name: Marshall Islands
countries.adoptedNote: Adopted 1979, twelve years before UN membership.

countries.name: Norway
countries.adoptedNote: Adopted 17 May 1814, in a union with Sweden until 1905.

countries.name: Palau
countries.adoptedNote: Approved by referendum in 1980, in force 1 January 1981.

countries.name: Saint Lucia
countries.adoptedNote: Adopted 1978, in force at independence in 1979.

countries.name: Serbia
countries.note: Successor to Yugoslavia and to Serbia and Montenegro (ruled 2026-09-01).

countries.name: Singapore
countries.adoptedNote: The state constitution of 1963 became the national constitution on independence in 1965.

countries.name: Slovakia
countries.adoptedNote: Adopted 1 September 1992, before the split from Czechoslovakia took effect.

countries.name: South Sudan
countries.adoptedNote: Transitional constitution of 9 July 2011, still the document in force.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.adoptedNote: Adopted 25 December 1947, on the mainland, before the 1949 move to Taipei.

countries.name: Tanzania
countries.note: Tanganyika then Tanzania. Zanzibar is code 511.

countries.name: Tonga
countries.adoptedNote: Granted 4 November 1875, the oldest in force in the Pacific.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.adoptedNote: Provisional from 2 December 1971, made permanent in 1996 without a new document.

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.note: DRV, then the unified state after 1976.
